ai.classification_prompt: Analyze the image and classify it into exactly one of the following categories: 'photo_drawing_or_comic', 'diagram', 'text' (mostly a short passage of text), 'table' (mostly a table), 'formula' (mostly a mathematical formula or equation), 'chart', 'infographic_or_depliant', 'document_scan' (a whole scanned or photographed page), 'logo_or_icon', 'map'. Reply ONLY with a valid JSON object containing a single key 'category' and the chosen category as the value. Do not include markdown blocks.

prompts.photo_drawing_or_comic: Accurate description of scene and subjects.
prompts.text: Transcription only, strictly preserving the original layout and formatting (use markdown).
prompts.table: Transcription only: reproduce the table as a markdown table, keeping every row and column.
prompts.formula: Transcription only: write the formula in LaTeX between $$ delimiters, nothing else.
prompts.chart: Extract key trends. Create a data table ONLY if exact numerical values are clearly readable; do NOT guess or hallucinate numbers.
prompts.infographic_or_depliant: Describe the layout and visual flow of the information.
prompts.document_scan: Transcribe all the text exactly as it appears in the scan, preserving the structure and formatting as much as possible.
prompts.logo_or_icon: Briefly describe the logo, symbol, or icon without overcomplicating it.
prompts.map: Describe the map, its geographic or thematic focus, and any key legends or paths shown.
